chunks: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa: that he saw Abu Ja'far al-Thani (peace be upon him) throw the Jamarat while riding.
He threw the Jamarat while riding.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الثَّانِي: Abu Ja'far al-Thani (Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, peace be upon him)
key_terms.رَمَى الْجِمَارَ: threw the Jamarat (ritual stoning of the pillars)

ai.seo_question: Did the Imams throw the Jamarat while riding during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from Sahih al-Tahdhib highlights the practical flexibility (rukhas) granted to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) during the Hajj rituals, specifically permitting the throwing of the Jamarat while mounted. This establishes a key juristic precedent for those who are elderly, ill, or facing crowds, allowing them to fulfill the pillar of Ramy al-Jamarat without dismounting, thereby emphasizing ease within the ritual framework.
